name: Family Hub
summary: The whole family's organiser: share it and everyone adds to the shopping list, sees whose turn the chores are, and gets reminded about family plans.
handles: One shared shopping list anyone can add to and tick off, plus any other list (packing, gifts)
A fair chore rotation that moves daily or weekly, with swaps that trade turns
Credits whoever did a chore and posts a weekly scoreboard on Sunday
Family events with a reminder the evening before and 2 hours ahead
07:30 morning message: today's chores, events and what's on the shopping list
setup: Type the family's first names, one per line, so chores rotate between them.
Adjust the chores list: one per line, e.g. "Dishes daily" or "Trash weekly mon".
Share the agent with the family (Settings → Shared with) so everyone can message it.

fields.label: Family members
fields.help: First names, one per line. Chores rotate in this order.

fields.label: Chores
fields.help: One per line: chore, then daily or weekly plus a day, e.g. "Trash weekly mon".
fields.default:
Dishes daily
Trash weekly mon
Laundry weekly sat
Bathroom weekly sun

after: Share it with your family under Settings → Shared with, then say "chores" to see today's rota or "add eggs" to start the shopping list.
